name: Mars
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
notes: CR 20+. Divine antagonist. Legendary actions x3. Legendary resistances (3). Session 5 only.
gm_notes: Session 5 final encounter. Legendary Resistances (3/day): auto-succeed on failed saves. Legendary Actions (3/round, end of others' turns): Strike, Divine Presence (DC 18 WIS or frightened), or Summon Undead. Three possible outcomes: destroy the spear (Brutus wins), bind the spear again (status quo), or redirect Mars's attention (players win). The encounter has multiple possible resolutions -- divine + political + personal threads all resolve here. See chapter5.qmd for full mechanics.
objective: Reclaim the spear that was bound against his will three generations ago.
goal: Destabilize the frontier to create the conditions for a new war.
agenda: Test whether the assembled unit is worthy of his attention or beneath notice.
secret: He could have taken the spear at any time. He has been waiting to be asked.
